_doc: SUPPLY (supplement) boxes for the local server, R4 section 5 schema; loaded by backend_server/supplement_catalog.py, which merges local_update/logs/client_tables.json (exported by the hook from the game's own tables) over this file. boxes: keyed by the game's numeric supplementID as a string. cost/multiCost currency: 'gp' | 'diamond' | 'sp' | a const.MallCurrencyType int (GP=1, YUANBAO=2, SP=3, PAY_YUANBAO=7, ...). pools: weighted entries {weight, item, count, days, quality, src} (item = real hall-prop/appearance id shown by UIItemDisplay; quality = const.HallPropQuality 1..5, GUESSED from the category; days 0 = permanent) or {weight, currency, amount, displayItem} (displayItem = const.CURRENCY_ID_2_CURRENCY_ITEM_ID: 200001 GP, 201001 diamond; optional). availability: what queryAvailableSupplement returns per id (entry keys unknown; {} works). PROVENANCE: box ids 1 and 2 = general boxes seen working in-game (R1); 9330 = const.WEEKLY_CAR_SUPPLEMENT_ID, 31 = const.ANNIVERSARY_ANCHOR_GIFT_SUPPLEMENT_ID (new_ros_python_runtime.json objects). 'Gold Supply' = supplement_utils.suppleKindToName[1]. Item ids come from the runtime samples in rpc_catalog.json feature_data.supplement.candidates: dts_appearance_preload.dataGunID2AppearanceIDList[20002] (gun skins 120xxx/121xxx), vehicleAppearanceData[130002] (vehicle skins 140xxx/142xxx), BattlegroundProps[1] (104xxx/106xxx/108903), BodyAppearanceDict (102568), WearableAndDecorationAppearanceDict (1111382), EmojiDict (980001), TransformSuitDict (1600001), dts_const.NIL_BLADE_* (120996, 121075). Prices, weights, kinds of 9330/31, free timers and guarantees are offline defaults (guesses), not game data; 31 is not in availability because it is an anchor-gift box, not a shop tab.
